8-collapsible-1.tsx.notes: AnimatedAlign heightFactor 0<->1 inside ClipRect animates the body height; ClipRRect(11) inside the 1px border inset matches the inner radius.

8-collapsible-2.tsx.notes: No ClipRect around the AnimatedAlign, so the overflowing body is clipped only by the Container's outer rounded rect and text can paint over the 1px bottom border mid-animation (barely visible).

8-collapsible-3.tsx.notes: Body uses alignment topCenter, so a short body paragraph would sit horizontally centered rather than left-aligned (not required by the brief).
